sections.Profile:
Released in April 1953, "Grand Slam" is an electro-mechanical machine that was designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. It features two flippers, three pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two slingshots, four standup targets, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
